verdicts.reason: I can't see a meaningful difference between A and B; they look the same apart from about a pixel of offset. Both have the same flaws. The crane photo is gone. The body copy is cramped right against the top of the brick image, the image fills a narrow column with wide empty side margins, and nothing anchors the layout as a newsletter sign-up.
